entities.name: Can a shared policy contract preserve independent checking within the size bound?
entities.summary: Test a declarative shared-policy contract with independently compiled evaluators after all three prior checker prototypes exceeded the frozen size gate.

entities.name: Recut the independent resolution checker
entities.summary: Prototype and exhaustively measure a faithful declarative shared-policy boundary without weakening authority separation or the size gate.

acceptance: Complete v1 claim, report, mutation, and presentation-order corpus passes
Generic checker, recipe custody, canonical binding, execution, and observation authority remain separate
Exhaustive symmetric classification catches an unclassified validity path
Checker imports no production adjudicator, model adapter, or execution machinery
Adjudication decision core is at most 70% of production under identical accounting
The shared policy contract and correlated defects remain explicit

relations.summary: The uncertainty defines the competing experiments and rejection criteria.
An accepted recut would change the resolution-verification boundary without changing policy meaning.
